correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the exact source NOD: fixed active seed and symmetric inactive coordinates reduce the piecewise-clipped n-agent flow to xdot=min(1-x,q(x)). The polynomial identity q=(x-s)^2+2s(sqrt(tau_c)-sqrt(tau))x holds for all declared parameters; strict positivity, its double root, or its small root respectively force x->1, x->s (exact x=gamma*t/(1+s*t)), or x->r_-<s. Strict LTM with a single seed activates iff 1>tau. At tau=1, saturation is inactive for x<=1/2; the exact arctangent quadrature has D~sqrt(n-2)*gamma^(3/4), giving pi/sqrt(n-2) times gamma^(-3/4). Checked boundary n=2, equality tau=tau_c, gamma bound, admissible mu>0, uniqueness and finite checker using actual local file. The limit is not asserted uniform in n and finite checks are not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Provides a sharp, nonvanishing-for-every-gamma counterexample to removing a central nondegeneracy assumption in continuous/discrete contagion equivalence; classifies the entire nontrivial NOD cascade interval, isolates n=3 as the first anomalous population size, gives the exact critical trajectory and a quantitative singular activation clock of exponent -3/4 with coefficient pi/sqrt(n-2). The precise threshold and clock matter to distinguish genuine cascade sets from long finite-time plateaus in the motivating network model; not an arbitrary numeric slice or mere computation.
